text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"opening hook and preview of position","quality":"engaging introduction","description":"It opens with a lively attention-getter that sets up the topic and the writer's stance in a more developed way."},{"evidence":"\"However...\" and \"some people might argue\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges an opposing view and attempts to answer it rather than only repeating its own position."},{"evidence":"\"driverless cars are not completely driverless right now\"","quality":"qualifying reasoning","description":"It shows more nuance by limiting its claims and distinguishing between current technology and future possibilities."},{"evidence":"final paragraph restating present vs future","quality":"conclusion and synthesis","description":"It closes by summarizing the argument and connecting the present-day judgment to a broader future outlook."},{"evidence":"ideas about sensors refining technology and helping other fields","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It expands points beyond simple claims, giving more explanation of why the technology matters and how it might be used."}]}
